text: 国泰海通第三批“证券、基金、保险公司互换便利（SFISF）”业务完成前期准备工作，已开展回购融资交易，并完成首批股票买入操作。国泰海通表示，将继续利用互换便利工具，增持A股股票及股票ETF。（证券时报）
text_en: Guotai Haitong completed the preliminary preparations for the third batch of Securities, Funds and Insurance Companies Swap Facility (SFISF) business, has conducted repo financing transactions, and completed the first batch of stock purchase operations. Guotai Haitong stated that it will continue to use the swap facility tool to increase holdings of A-share stocks and stock ETFs. (Securities Times)
